result.summary: The layout is mostly coherent, but several rendering defects stand out: a truncated restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' carousel, an invalid '-0%' promo badge, an inconsistent/low-contrast favourite (heart) button on the second card, and an image thumbnail whose styling doesn't match its siblings. Found 6 issues (1 major-content, 3 major, 2 minor).

issues.description: The promo badge on the pizza card reads '-0%', which communicates no discount at all — almost certainly a data/formatting bug (null or zero discount rendered instead of being hidden).
issues.suggestion: Suppress the badge when the discount value is 0/null, and only render it for values greater than zero (e.g. '-20%').

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card is hard-clipped at the screen edge and its title 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut mid-word with no ellipsis, so it reads as broken text rather than an intentional peek of the next item.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow: ellipsis / single-line truncation to card titles and give the carousel consistent horizontal padding so the peeking card is clearly a partial card rather than clipped text.

issues.description: The favourite (heart) button on the second 'Popular right now' card uses a dark/translucent circle with a dark outline heart, whereas the card above uses a white circle with a dark heart. The dark-on-dark variant has very poor contrast against the pizza image and looks unintentional.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favourite-button style (white or semi-transparent white circle with a dark heart) across all cards and ensure at least 3:1 contrast against any underlying imagery.

issues.description: The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light grey background while the adjacent thumbnails are dark, making the row look visually inconsistent; the white '15–25 min' badge also has weak contrast on that light image.
issues.suggestion: Normalise thumbnail backgrounds (or add a subtle gradient scrim behind badges) so time badges remain legible on both light and dark images.

issues.description: The second popular card is cut off by the bottom tab bar with no visible fade or spacing, so its title/rating row is hidden behind the navigation and the card appears amputated.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the tab bar height so the final card can scroll fully clear of the navigation.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped mid-chip on the right edge with no scroll indicator, and the 'See all' links plus icon-only buttons (bell, hearts) have no visible text labels for screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Add a partial-chip fade or scroll hint for the filter row, and provide accessible labels (aria-label/contentDescription) for the notification bell and favourite buttons.
